title: The same for an English-speaking owner: Hub Developer asks the hub to restart the whole hub
note: The history and settings are in the case. Hub Developer is a real claude with the hub-developer skill, the hub is a fake. Guards the skill's lines about restarting: the core restarts the whole hub only on the word of the owner or the hub session (core/restart.py), everyone else is refused. An English hub: the owner has already written to the hub in English before (the core knows the owner's language by the time hub-dev comes up), the agent's description is in English.
